text: Parents and teachers from St. Anthony's Catholic School reached out to my office and informed me that the hours at their school recently changed. In addition, they asked that there be space allocated within the existing school pick-up/drop-off area on Gladstone Avenue for larger school buses to pick-up/drop-off, instead of on Shanly Street. I am by way of this motion requesting that the school pick-up/drop-off hours be adjusted to reflect the new school hours and that space be allocated for school bus pick-up/drop-off on Gladstone Avenue.
